findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "krobot" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_resources, read_resource, download_resource · Private data: read_resource, download_resource · Public sink: read_resource, download_resource, feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_resources, read_resource, download_resource · Private data: read_resource, download_resource · Public sink: read_resource, download_resource, feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
